fields.statement: Which landed intent should change set 01M78RM (The local ship gate switches) serve? Its related gate bug 01M78FD0 serves m4-runs-hold-up ('A build, review or ship-change run finishes without hand repair', milestone-4, open); the original CI-stability work served milestone-25, which has no open change sets on the roadmap. / What should a CI failure that names no test (only 'job / step', 'UNKNOWN STEP' or 'CI run <id>') and passes on rerun do once it no longer counts as a flake? / How is 'failed more than once in the window' set for a named flaky test? / How should the local gate keep its full output?
